human_intervention_taxonomy.label: ethics_concern
human_intervention_taxonomy.trigger: task instruction conflicts with safety policy

hypotheses.claim: Event-bound structured intervention produces more reliable continual improvement than unstructured reflection or prompt rewrites.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Within equal budget, the Event-bound arm does not exceed a plain reflection baseline on the held-out project family.
required_evidence: Reverse replication on at least one cross-domain family

hypotheses.claim: Combining self-experience and external knowledge resolves gaps neither source can resolve alone.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Combined arm never exceeds the stronger single-source arm on the same budget.
required_evidence: Negative cases where one source dominates

hypotheses.claim: Choosing learning actions based on identified gap, expected value, and cost outperforms fixed-cadence learning.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Fixed-cadence schedule matches or beats cost-aware selection.
required_evidence: Equal-budget A/B on three project families

hypotheses.claim: Frozen expectations, independent tests, and regression constraints reduce erroneous promotions and predict future performance.
hypotheses.falsification_condition: Visible-test gains do not predict hidden-task gains, or the system promotes a regression more than 1 in 20 rounds.
